rows.en: (Let's see... What's my next class......)
Whoa-ho!!

Owww...
Sorry, Hoshimura. You okay?
I'm fine, I'm fine!
But you sure got lucky, \p...
Huh? Lucky?

The hazardous stuff I'm carrying
could've expl......
rows.notes: Deliberately cut off mid-word, as in the Japanese ('bakuha').

rows.en: Er, never mind, nothing! See ya!

(I'd better be careful never to bump into
Hoshimura again...)

Ugh...
Sorry, Yui. Are you okay?

(I'd better be careful never to bump into
Yui again...)
Yum, yum......

(Field rations for Hoshimura's lunch again
today, huh...)

Hoshimura, you eat nothing but field rations.
Why do you like them so much?

They're easy to eat, so they're convenient!
My favorite part is that I can eat them
while I'm tinkering with machines!

But if field rations are your staple food,
your diet can't be very balanced.

I eat steak to build up my strength...
And I think about a balanced diet too, so I
make sure to get my veggies with pineapple salad!

Oh, changing the subject, but lately
I've gotten really into making music boxes...

Hoshimura...
If you ever get dragged out to a battlefield,
never, ever eat steak and pineapple salad.
And you'd better quit making music boxes, too...
Hm? Why?

I just...
I just have a feeling about it......
What in tarnation is that supposed to mean?

(It's just my imagination that I saw
the shadow of death on Hoshimura... right?)

(Field rations for Yui's lunch again
today, huh...)

Yui, you eat nothing but field rations.
Why do you like them so much?

But if field rations are your staple food,
your diet can't be very balanced.

Yui...
If you ever get dragged out to a battlefield,
never, ever eat steak and pineapple salad.

I just...
I just have a feeling about it......

(It's just my imagination that I saw
the shadow of death on Yui... right?)
(My EX-Gear training partner today is Hoshimura.)
I'm counting on you, Hoshimura.
Right back atcha~!

Oh, that reminds me, I went and developed
a new booster unit.
Wow, that's amazing.

So I want to check how it behaves when it's
mounted, and I'd be really happy if you'd try
it on for me...
...It's safe, right?

Well, duh! It bears the Yui-brand stamp!
It's the coolest piece of work there is,
I tell ya!
(That's exactly what worries me most...)

A monster-class booster that puts out as much
power as the booster units on a Valkyrie!
With this, you'll become the wind, guaranteed!
I'll pass, thanks!
Whaaat~! Why~?
Well, you ask why, but...

(Because I'd probably end up becoming
the wind for real...)
(My EX-Gear training partner today is Yui.)
I'm counting on you, Yui.
Wow, that's amazing.
...It is safe, right?

(Because I'd probably end up becoming
the wind for real...)

(Okay, how should I spend my day off
tomorrow?)

Yahooo~~!
Tomorrow's a day off~!! Yeahhh!
Hoshimura, you're getting way too excited...

Well, c'mon~, a day off is free time all day long!
What could be more wonderful than that?

Well, that's true, but...
Hoshimura, what do you do on your days off?

Lemme see...
When I wake up, first I start tinkering
with machines...
When I get tired, I take a nap!

Then I wake up and tinker some more,
and by then it's already pretty late, so...
I guess I go to bed!

(It's a very Hoshimura way to spend
a day off, I'll give her that...)

(But is that really an okay way for a girl
in the prime of her high school years
to spend her days off?)
Yui, you're getting way too excited...

Well, that's true, but...
Yui, what do you do on your days off?
O-oh~, I see...

(It's a very Yui way to spend
a day off, I'll give her that...)

(But is that really an okay way for a girl
in the prime of her high school years
to spend her days off?)

uncertain: c20102/c20111/c20103/c20107: the player warns Yui off steak and pineapple salad and music boxes as death flags (anime-style jinxes); kept literal, no explanation added.
c20106: 'nanjai sorya' rendered with old-fashioned 'What in tarnation' for Yui's old-man speech (archaic form in the Japanese).
c20096/c20097: keitaishoku -> 'field rations', as in scd_com_102 (c21222).
